title: Decision made
description: One decision of an enforcement point (sections 6 and 8). A denied agent.stop never keeps the agent from stopping: that action is evaluated for the evidence only (section 6.3).

reason.description: Why the decision was taken (section 6.6). Never gate.evidence_full: a denial with it is the one decision not recorded, since the evidence buffer cannot take it (EP-8).

resource.description: What the action applies to (section 6.3). A resource ID longer than 512 characters, which makes the request invalid, is recorded as its SHA-256, in id_sha256 rather than id (section 8.3).

id_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of a resource ID longer than 512 characters, recorded in place of the ID.

environment.description: The environment that the enforcement point's registration returned (I-7). Required with the reasons of a decision that evaluated policies: policy.permit, policy.forbid, policy.no_permit, error.evaluation and error.timeout. A decision taken before a registration returned one carries none.

policies.description: White Tower policy IDs that determined the decision.

bundle_version.description: The version of the bundle that decided (section 6.6): always with policy.permit, policy.forbid, policy.no_permit and error.evaluation, never with the gate's reasons, and optional with error.timeout, error.unknown_agent and error.invalid_request.

evaluation_us.description: Time spent deciding, gate included, in microseconds.

arguments.description: What the enforcement point records about the call's arguments, as configured (section 8.3): their names, or, in the hashed mode, an HMAC with its key's ID. Never their values.

names.description: The arguments' names, each of at most 128 characters.

names_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of each argument name longer than 128 characters, recorded in place of the name.

hmac_sha256.description: The hashed mode: the HMAC-SHA-256, in lowercase hexadecimal, of the canonical JSON (section 1) of the arguments object as the tool receives it, with the deployment's key that key_id names.

key_id.description: The ID of the deployment's key that computed hmac_sha256.
